name: XMPlayer
description: Plays IPTV streams from M3U or Xtream Codes.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; frame-src 'self' https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com https://*.youtube.com https://*.youtube-nocookie.com data: https://tmdb-proxy.xerge-gaming-info.workers.dev; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; font-src 'self' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com data:; connect-src * blob: data:; img-src 'self' https://*:* http://*:* data: blob:; media-src 'self' https://*:* http://*:* blob: data:;
